models_evaluated: AI algorithm detecting spatio-temporal electrogram dispersion (tailored ablation)

links.outcome: Freedom from documented AF at 12 months, AI-guided tailored ablation vs PVI-only, plus safety
links.effect: Primary endpoint met: 88% tailored vs 70% anatomical (log-rank P<0.0001). No significant difference in freedom from any atrial arrhythmia after one ablation. Safety endpoint did not differ; procedure and ablation times twice as long.
links.quote: However, no significant difference between arms was observed for the freedom from any atrial arrhythmia endpoint after one ablation.

screen.reason: This is a randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical efficacy and safety of an AI-guided electrogram mapping system used during live ablation procedures for persistent atrial fibrillation compared to standard care.
